question: The amount of debt that will be discharged by 5 equal monthly instalments of ₹1,845 each, at the rate of 48% simple interest per annum, is:
solution:

The amount of debt will be discharged by 5 equal monthly installments of ₹1,845 each, at the rate of 48% simple interest per annum.

**Formula used:**

Total debt = Sum of all installments (including interest)

Interest per installment = Principal × rate × time
